sources.snippet: This page documents the deployment and optimization of the gated DeepSeek V4 Flash Abliterated model variant (drowzeys/keys-DeepSeekV4-Flash-GA-0731-Dspark-Abliterated-32-32). This model uses the DeepseekV4ForCausalLM architecture with 256 routed experts and 1 shared expert, utilizing NVFP4 (4-bit float) for expert weights and FP8 for attention mechanisms runbook-deepseek-v4-flash-abliterated ...
